Downloaded 2026-11-27.

Original GLB is retained (648 triangles). Derived OBJs preserve geometry and flat
normals, transform coordinates and separate the wings. Game adaptations include
URP materials, resizing, growth-stage accessories and procedural motion.
No endorsement by the original creator is implied.
This is a stylized game character adapted from a generic fly, not a scientific model.
Conversion tool: tools/convert_fly_asset.py (numpy required).
